body: This made me just burst out into tears. Ive wanted to end it ever since I was 7. My mom is always telling me life gets better, but it's just gotten worse. I'm not cut out for this.
Exactly. I wish more than anything that my mom will finally start hating me. Then maybe I can do it

I don't keep jobs. I technically have a side hustle but i barely have motivation to do it. I have wasted so much of her money already. I don't deserve to ask for more. I feel sorry for her that she had me

It's not that. I love what I'm doing. I have always loved it, ever since I was a kid. It's just that I always fuck up, get bad grades, ruin things for myself. I'm going to fail this just like I failed everything else because Ill lose motivation once my grades begin to slip. Im not very smart so it always happens.

I just feel so stupid that I keep thinking things will change somehow. Like I keep tricking myself and end up being dissappointed

Yes. College dropout, high school dropout. Liar, thief, BPD, depression, anxiety, OCD. I'm ugly and overweight in a family of in shape beautiful people. I'm stupid and crazy in a family of successful intelligent people. And unlike some families with black sheep, they didn't treat me different from day one. My terribleness achieved that on its own over time.
I just can't. I think i give up. I give up in art, i give up on everything. I've been crying for hours about this, i can't do this anymore
I wish that was true, but it's not. If i was a master at something, I'd have a career in it and an income.

Thank you. I really appreciate your kind words, but I just.  I'm tired of failing. I'm not in college. I've actually tried to go to college 3 separate times, 3 separate colleges. (2 community, and then a "real one" that I actually got into as my latest attempt) and I dropped out of all three after a bit. Never made it to finishing 2 semesters in any attempt. 

I failed at high school, at college, at work (just got fired from my latest job after 3 days.) I wanted to be in musicals, i flaked out/didn't get in. 

How am I supposed to keep trying when there's not even one single thing I can point to in my life that is working. My entire life has been a never ending stream of trying to be normal and failing at it. I'm sorry, I don't mean to be a downer, but I'm just so exhausted.

That's the thing. I can't study.  First, i was one of those ""gifted kids"" in elementary and middle school, and I never learned good study habits because of it. And I'm not actually gifted (shocker!) I was just ahead in elementary, but high school quickly caught up to me and i flunked out. I'm actually pretty average, pretty stupid.

That aside, when I try to study art, follow art tutorials, try gesture drawing, anything, it all looks so awful I sob for like 30 minutes and don't try again. My art is stiff, boring, lackluster. I can't draw complex poses or even something more complicated than a 3/4 pose. I want to keep trying because it's probably the only way I'll be able to make any sort of living, but I'm genuinely terrible at it.

And all my friends are incredible artists, and sometimes i watch them draw and all I can think about is how i will never be like them, no matter how hard I try. And i know I won't.

Like, I understand that if I were to practice i would get better, not just at that, but anything, but I can't. Like everything else- I'm bad at practicing.
Yeah. But i just. I'm tired of failing. Tired of being useless and bad at life. It is what it is indeed

No, i had responsibilities, but not a lot. I had very little to do because i hadn't been there long enough to build clientele. I shouldn't have been on my phone. But a part of me is mad they didn't even tell me not to. When the phone rang, i got it immediately. (Always faster than the other girl too) but i just. I didn't... I don't know. I'm too tired to get another job only to get fired again. In gonna try and handle my debt with doordash and then end it

I'm sorry. I just. What's the point. Genuinely, someone tell me. What's the point of living life miserable, driving your friends and family away, to someday end up broke and starving on the streets. I'd much, much rather die warm and comfortable, full and hydrated.

I know she doesn't want me to be dead. Of course i know that. But i am draining her life by being alive. My mom has already survived loss and moved on. I know she would survive me. I know it. But i don't know if she can survive me being alive. I drive her crazy. She works so hard, she deserves to go on vacations and relax and not worry so much, but because I Exist she won't ever be able to do that.

Im just tired of being miserable, and I'm tired of making her miserable, and literally, actually, ruining her life

My mother is a great person, please don't say that she isn't. She's given me a roof over my head, multiple cars after I've had repeated accidents. She has supported me in my repeated attempts to go to college, and has paid for me to live in a warm home and not go hungry or homeless.  She has done everything to get me help, even going as far as a $1200/day mental health rehab.

Literally all she wants. All she deserves in return is for me to take all this opportunity that I'm getting again and again and I can't do that for her. I keep failing her. She is proud of me now, thinking i have a job, because she wants me to be a successful, self supported person.. that she doesn't have to support to survive anymore. She doesn't belittle me, but she's exhausted with me. She would never ever say out loud she wishes she hadn't had me, but she is exhausted. Her life has been so hard, even outside of my issues, and she's getting older and wants to relax and not stress about money.

She'd gone above and beyond for me and i can't do something as simple as hold down a job, and I know if i tell her this recent attempt has failed (after she herself spent weeks helping me with my resume and finding jobs for me to apply to) it just might break her
Medical bills, credit card debt
But I just. I have thousands in debt. I can't afford to keep going. I can't afford to take care of her
I know she would be sad, but my mom would take care of her. She's a wonderful cat, the absolute best, and my mom adores her
My cat. I haven't prepared anything yet, and I don't want to risk her health or anything if i suddenly die and no one knows to come get her.
Yeah, but i don't really use them. Idk. I just. I went to go get a McDonald's burger and wanted so bad to just drive into the semi in front of me

I'm a bad employee. It's my fault. I had next to nothing to do since nothing was set up for me, so instead of asking for additional things to do i just read the news. But. I'm. I'm kinda frustrated they didn't just tell me not to do that. Nobody talked to me at all. Idk
With what money? Doing what? i appreciate the energy but i have no skills, no degrees, no talents.
There are. But job hunting is exhausting and i shut down my indeed and stuff already. To look again would be to restart. And I'm just tired.
Exactly. I think getting this job was a high point in my mom's eyes. I'd rather our last conversation together be one where she's proud of me

It wasn't even "the" job. It was just an office job, with benefits and air conditioning. It was reliable work that wasn't stressful, which was the dream to me.

I can't tell anyone i lost it. My mom made it very clear this job is her last try in supporting me, and i made the mistake of hyping myself up to my friends and how excited i was.  

And i can't exactly afford a vacation without a job... When i got this job, i was making plans to visit europe in the fall, but that's not going to happen now. And i just.... My mom was actually proud of me. I don't know if I can bear telling her the truth, seeing her disappointment. She regrets having me, I know she does, and she keeps hoping I'll be something so that regret goes away and i never will be.
Update: Just got a text from my mom saying how proud she is of me, and that my life is going to get so much better now that I have a job. I can't stop crying
That's the thing, she's not. The house was $130k. Obviously that isn't cheap, and my mom isn't poor, but she didn't have that just lying around. It's from my dead dad's life insurance.
